description: Interior works comprising: new bathroom fittings; replacement boiler; new kitchen fittings; new plug sockets and light switches; replaster bedroom ceiling; painting of walls; replacement carpet; new light fittings; replacement door handles; new skirting board; replacement radiators; new drainage pipework; restore and paint outside balcony.
decision_conditions: The application, by the introduction of large, unsympathetic, and visually discordant radiators, would fail to preserve the special architectural and historic interest and heritage significance of the host Grade II* Listed Building, contrary to Section 16 of the Town Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservations Areas) Act 1990 and National Planning Policy Framework (2024). The application is therefore contrary to the Richmond Local Plan (2025) in particular policy 29 as supported by the relevant Supplementary Planning Documents, in particular, Listed Buildings.
